1. A written roadmap that breaks down every governmental filing, permit, and fee we will face in the U.S. and in Panama, linked to a realistic timeline.

3. A zoning and land-use opinion for at least two candidate parcels, showing compliance hurdles and estimated costs to cure any issues. 
4. A concise budget estimate for the entire legal process with suggestions on where we can safely reduce expenses without cutting corners.

Once I review the roadmap and documents, I’ll schedule follow-up questions and, if everything aligns, extend the engagement into full representation through closing and permit approvals.
